annotation.justification: The use of 'MAY' is ambiguous. It could mean simply permitted, or it could imply a recommendation or expectation. Without further clarification, implementations could reasonably choose to always advertise support, or to only do so under specific conditions.
annotation.missing_information: The degree to which 'MAY' implies encouragement or optionality is not clarified. This affects implementation choices regarding whether to include reserved version advertisements by default.
